description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LoraProviderMalformedPayloadException' used in the LoRa adapter provider package to signify that a received message contains a malformed payload.

classes.name: LoraProviderMalformedPayloadException
classes.description: A custom RuntimeException indicating that a LoRa message payload is malformed.

methods.name: LoraProviderMalformedPayloadException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and cause.
